profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company, traded under the ticker DDOG, with headquarters in New York, NY and CIK 0001561550. On its own site the company describes its core offering as cloud monitoring as a service, presenting a way to see metrics from all of an organization's apps, tools and services in one place, and it invites visitors to try the product for free.

The site's security messaging is framed around AI. Datadog describes helping organizations defend against AI-powered attacks, and says that integrating security and observability lets them decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response with what it calls agentic speed, in order to stay ahead of sophisticated threats.

The facts held on the company list no individual products and no MCP servers. Its law exposure is recorded under New York with a count of 424, and no specific cases are named.
